1.why: I have some chemistry background but math is not my favorite subject.

2.why: Basic arithmetic is fine but decimals can be tricky sometimes.

3.why: Geometry feels abstract and I struggle with visualizing angles.

4.why: Algebra is one of the subjects I dislike most in school.

5.why: Trigonometry is very difficult and I rarely encounter it.

6.why: Volume calculations relate to chemistry but I am not sure.

7.why: Sketching curves is completely outside my comfort zone.

8.why: Fractions are manageable but I prefer chemistry over math.

9.why: Finding missing sides requires geometry skills I lack.

1.why: I feel a bit anxious using math book tables but it is not a big fear for me usually.

2.why: Thinking about a test one day before causes me moderate stress and worry about my performance.

3.why: Watching a teacher work equations is okay I can focus but feel slightly nervous sometimes.

4.why: Taking a math exam makes me feel moderate anxiety especially since I dislike economics and biology too.

5.why: Given difficult homework due next class makes me feel a bit stressed but not overly anxious.

6.why: Listening to lectures in math class is not anxiety provoking for me I find it mostly fine.

7.why: Hearing another student explain a formula feels easy and I do not experience any anxiety at all.

8.why: A pop quiz in class makes me feel moderately anxious because I am not fully prepared.

9.why: Starting a new chapter feels slightly worrying but I usually manage to cope with the new material.

6.why: I have moderate confidence in getting good grades, though my anxiety about performance keeps me from being certain.
